_comment: Config for drc_audit — the deterministic gate for step 9 (DRC). Read-only: COMPOSES the existing drc_check tool (headless kicad-cli DRC against the board's own .kicad_pro rules) and turns its result into a hard pass/fail per the master-flow step-9 rules: errors=0, unconnected=0, shorts=0, silk not on pads. drc_check already runs DRC against the SAME rule set board_setup_audit validates, so there's one authoritative constraint source. Cached; RESTART backend after edits. Verdict in words.
_rule_source: Master flow step 9 (DRC) + drc_check + pcb_verify silk-on-pad.

drc_errors._rule: Rule 1 — DRC errors = 0 (hard gate): clearance, track width, hole spacing, overlapping copper. Any error-severity violation blocks.

unconnected._rule: Rule 2 — unconnected items = 0. A ratsnest line left at DRC time is a hard block (routing incomplete).

shorts._rule: Rule 3 — shorts = 0. Any violation whose type/description names a short is a hard block.

silk_on_pad._rule: Rule 4 — silkscreen not on pads / not clipped. Reuses pcb_verify's structural silk-over-pad check.

verdict.clean: DRC VERIFIED — 0 errors, 0 unconnected, 0 shorts ({w} warning(s))
verdict.issues: DRC NOT CLEAN — {e} error(s), {u} unconnected, {s} short(s), {w} warning(s)
verdict.unavailable: DRC UNAVAILABLE — kicad-cli DRC could not run (KiCad/board issue, not a design fail)
